Requirement Location:
RISC-V Unpriv. ISA, F extension: Single-Precision Floating-Point Compare Instructions
RISC-V Unpriv. ISA, D extension: Double-Precision Floating-Point Compare Instructions
RISC-V Unpriv. ISA, Zfh chapter (CVA6 XF16 config): Half-Precision Floating-Point Compare Instructions
IEEE 754-2008: 5.6.1 (compareQuietEqual, compareSignalingLess/LessEqual), 5.11
Feature Description:
rd (integer) = 1 if the relation holds, else 0.
- FEQ is quiet: NV only for an sNaN operand.
- FLT/FLE are signaling: NV for any NaN operand.
- Any NaN operand → rd = 0.
- −0 == +0.
Verification Goal:
1. 3 ops × every operand-class pair × fmt (3 × 10 × 10 × 3 = 900 bins).
2. 3 ops × result 0/1 × fmt (18 bins).
3. fflags: no exception, NV.
Pass/Fail Criteria:
fpu_sb compares every response against the C/MPFR ref model:
- result_o bit-exact (incl. NaN-boxing of FP32/FP16 results)
- fpu_exception_o.cause (fflags) bit-exact
- each response matched to its request by trans_id; a response with no pending request is an error
Pass = 0 UVM_ERROR / UVM_FATAL in the test log.
Implementation:
fpu_noncomput_cov::cg_compare
- cx_fcmp_op1_x_op2: cp_op × cp_op1_class × cp_op2_class × cp_fmt
- cx_fcmp_op_x_res: cp_op × cp_result × cp_fmt
- cp_flags {NO_EXCEPTION, NV}
Op decoded from rm[1:0] (0 = FLE, 1 = FLT, 2 = FEQ).
Tests:
fpu_random_test, fpu_single_op_test, fpu_op_group_test,
fpu_fmt_random_test, fpu_fmt_single_op_test, fpu_fmt_op_group_test,
fpu_random_op_bp_test, fpu_op_group_bp_test (back-to-back),
fpu_special_val_test (ZERO/INF/QNaN/SNaN operands)

RISC-V Unpriv. ISA, D extension: Double-Precision Floating-Point Classify Instruction
RISC-V Unpriv. ISA, Zfh chapter (CVA6 XF16 config): Half-Precision Floating-Point Classify Instruction
IEEE 754-2008: 5.7.2 (class)
Feature Description:
rd = 10-bit one-hot class mask:
bit 0 −INF, 1 −normal, 2 −subnormal, 3 −0, 4 +0, 5 +subnormal, 6 +normal, 7 +INF, 8 sNaN, 9 qNaN.
Never sets fflags. An improperly NaN-boxed input is classified as canonical qNaN.
Verification Goal:
1. Every input class × fmt (30 bins).
2. Each of the 10 one-hot result values (10 bins); any multi-bit result is an illegal bin.
Pass/Fail Criteria:
fpu_sb compares every response against the C/MPFR ref model:
- result_o bit-exact (incl. NaN-boxing of FP32/FP16 results)
- fpu_exception_o.cause (fflags) bit-exact
- each response matched to its request by trans_id; a response with no pending request is an error
Pass = 0 UVM_ERROR / UVM_FATAL in the test log.
One-hot property also enforced by cp_res_class illegal_bins (error on hit).
Implementation:
fpu_noncomput_cov::cg_classify
- cx_fclass_x_fmt_x_rnd: cp_op_class × cp_fmt
- cp_res_class (10 bins + illegal_bins multi_bit = default)
Tests:
fpu_random_test, fpu_single_op_test, fpu_op_group_test,
fpu_fmt_random_test, fpu_fmt_single_op_test, fpu_fmt_op_group_test,
fpu_random_op_bp_test, fpu_op_group_bp_test (back-to-back),

IEEE 754-2008: 5.5.1 (copy, non-computational)
Feature Description:
rd (integer) = raw bit pattern of rs1, sign-extended from the format width to XLEN.
- No rounding, no flags.
- NaN payloads (canonical or not, quiet or signaling) are copied unchanged.
- Exempt from the NaN-boxing check: the low bits are moved even if rs1 is not properly boxed.
Verification Goal:
1. Every source class × fmt (30 bins).
2. NaN kind × fmt: canonical qNaN, non-canonical qNaN, sNaN (9 bins).
3. Properly / improperly boxed source × fmt (FP64 improperly boxed ignored: an FP64 value fills FLen) (5 bins).
Pass/Fail Criteria:
fpu_sb compares every response against the C/MPFR ref model:
- result_o bit-exact (incl. NaN-boxing of FP32/FP16 results)
- fpu_exception_o.cause (fflags) bit-exact
- each response matched to its request by trans_id; a response with no pending request is an error
Pass = 0 UVM_ERROR / UVM_FATAL in the test log.
Implementation:
fpu_noncomput_cov::cg_move_f2x
- cx_op_class_x_fmt
- cx_nan_kind_x_fmt (fpu_common_pkg::nan_kind, box check off)
- cx_boxed_x_fmt (ignore_bins fp64_always_boxed)
fpu_wrap maps FMV_F2X to fpnew SGNJ with rm = 011 (raw passthrough).
Tests:
fpu_random_test, fpu_single_op_test, fpu_op_group_test,
fpu_fmt_random_test, fpu_fmt_single_op_test, fpu_fmt_op_group_test,

Pass/Fail Criteria:
fpu_sb compares every response against the C/MPFR ref model:
- result_o bit-exact (incl. NaN-boxing of FP32/FP16 results)
- fpu_exception_o.cause (fflags) bit-exact
- each response matched to its request by trans_id; a response with no pending request is an error
Pass = 0 UVM_ERROR / UVM_FATAL in the test log.
Implementation:
fpu_noncomput_cov::cg_move_x2f
- cx_op_class_x_fmt
- cx_nan_kind_x_fmt
- cx_src_upper_x_fmt (cp_src_upper from x2f_src_upper(); FP64 ignore_bins: no upper bits at XLEN = 64)
Tests:
fpu_random_test, fpu_single_op_test, fpu_op_group_test,

rd = rs1 magnitude with sign = rs2.sign / ~rs2.sign / rs1.sign ^ rs2.sign.
- Non-arithmetic: no flags, NaN payloads (incl. sNaN) kept unchanged.
- Pseudo-ops with rs1 = rs2: FMV (FSGNJ), FNEG (FSGNJN), FABS (FSGNJX).
- An improperly boxed input is treated as canonical qNaN before injection.

1. 3 ops × rs1 class × rs2 sign × fmt (3 × 10 × 2 × 3 = 180 bins).
2. FMV/FNEG/FABS pseudo-ops (rs1 = rs2) × fmt (9 bins).
3. 3 ops × rs1 NaN kind (canonical qNaN, non-canonical qNaN, sNaN) (9 bins).
Pass/Fail Criteria:
fpu_sb compares every response against the C/MPFR ref model:
- result_o bit-exact (incl. NaN-boxing of FP32/FP16 results)
- fpu_exception_o.cause (fflags) bit-exact
- each response matched to its request by trans_id; a response with no pending request is an error
Pass = 0 UVM_ERROR / UVM_FATAL in the test log.
Implementation:
fpu_noncomput_cov::cg_sign_injection
- cx_fsgn_x_sign_x_fmt: cp_fsgn_op × cp_op_class × cp_op2_sign × cp_fmt
- cx_pseudo_op: cp_fsgn_op × cp_same × cp_fmt
- cx_fsgn_x_nan_kind: cp_fsgn_op × cp_nan_kind

Requirement Location:
RISC-V Unpriv. ISA, D extension: NaN Boxing of Narrower Values
RISC-V Unpriv. ISA, Zfh chapter (CVA6 XF16 config): NaN boxing of half-precision values in FLen = 64
Feature Description:
With FLen = 64, a valid FP32/FP16 operand has all bits above its width set to 1.
Any other upper-bit pattern makes the operand an implicit canonical qNaN for every operation that reads it as a float.
Exempt: FMV.X.* / FMV.*.X (raw transfers) and integer sources (FCVT.*.W/L).
Verification Goal:
For each operand port the operation reads as a float, properly and improperly boxed × op × fmt:
- operand_a: every op except FADD, FSUB, FCVT_I2F, FMV_X2F
- operand_b: FADD, FSUB, FMUL, FDIV, FMA ×4, FCMP, FMIN_MAX, FSGNJ
- imm (rs3 / FADD rs2): FADD, FSUB, FMA ×4
FP64 × improperly boxed is ignored (FP64 fills FLen), except FCVT_F2F operand_a, whose source format comes from imm[1:0].
Pass/Fail Criteria:
fpu_sb compares every response against the C/MPFR ref model:
- result_o bit-exact (incl. NaN-boxing of FP32/FP16 results)
- fpu_exception_o.cause (fflags) bit-exact
- each response matched to its request by trans_id; a response with no pending request is an error
Pass = 0 UVM_ERROR / UVM_FATAL in the test log.
Implementation:
fpu_agent_cov_model::cg_fpu_request
- cx_box_a_x_op_x_fmt (ignore_bins not_fp, fp64)
- cx_box_b_x_op_x_fmt (ignore_bins not_read, fp64)
- cx_box_c_x_op_x_fmt (ignore_bins not_read, fp64)
Boxing evaluated with fpu_common_pkg::operand_is_boxed against the source format.
Tests:
fpu_random_test, fpu_single_op_test, fpu_op_group_test,
fpu_fmt_random_test, fpu_fmt_single_op_test, fpu_fmt_op_group_test,
fpu_random_op_bp_test, fpu_op_group_bp_test (back-to-back),
fpu_special_val_test (ZERO/INF/QNaN/SNaN operands)
Notes:
fpu_txn leaves 10 % of requests unboxed (m_nan_box_c); those operands have all-zero upper bits.
Only FMV_X2F also gets random upper bits; other patterns are not separately binned.
Canonical-NaN substitution checked by the scoreboard.
